mentions.name: Social Maps
mentions.description: A user reviews and ratings service for points-of-interest (e.g. cafes, museums, shops) in the OpenStreetMap database. It is a CRUD app with OpenStreetMap-specific features such as logging in with OpenStreetMap and querying places by their OSM metadata, and offers docs, an OpenAPI-spec API reference, a demo app with the entire planet imported and queryable, and an early-stage Android SDK.
mentions.problem: The lack of user reviews and ratings was a big pain point when trying to switch away from Google Maps and reduce reliance on Big Tech.
mentions.audience: The service targets people looking to reduce reliance on Big Tech and switch away from Google Maps, needing reviews and ratings for places.
